sourceRules: Phone uses original __pgLife.day().segs, not a synthetic new store. Original cfg.demo is explicitly mode demo, source=2 for every demo row.
Automatic guess=true maps source1; automatic !guess maps source0. Do not equate day.real=true with all observed.
Project only start<cutoff and clamp end<=cutoff; discard zero-length future rows; do not fill missing gaps.
start/end must integers0..1440, start<end, ascending nonoverlapping across whole transfer; unknown kind maps none6. Place maps category/id to enum only, no coordinates/private place names.
If >96 filtered rows, explicitly report TOO_MANY_DAY_SEGMENTS; do not silently truncate/merge across provenance or invent coverage.

mode/date/zone/cutoff/clientId/petId/transfer/parts identical in all parts; first part0 replaces staging. Part must equal expected next index; exact duplicate same transfer/part may respond accepted but must not append twice.
Device accepts only current saved owner clientId and petId; no bound snapshot or owner mismatch rejects, no mutation of binding.

Cache in RAM only. Atomic replace visible day only after last valid part. Incomplete failed transfer leaves last complete day visible/labelled old, never claims new complete. Date change replaces whole complete day; fresh boot empty until phone resends.
Empty day part0/parts1/segments[] commits explicit empty for that date.
Commands do not use mutation seq, do not advance lastSeq/lastAck/scene revision, do not write NVS/journal/event receipt or invoke reward. Owner copied inside data, not top-level mutation envelope.
errors: existing ok:false/error code/outcome:no_change for malformed, invalid bounds, wrong owner/pet, out-of-order. No persisted:true. RAM staging errors may discard staging only; no save writes.
